en.question: How long is Cloud Pro included with my device?
en.answer:
• Founders Limited Edition — 24 months of Cloud Pro included
• Signature Edition — 12 months of Cloud Pro included
• Standard Edition — 6 months of Cloud Pro included

Once your included period ends, everything keeps working — you simply return to Cloud Basic unless you choose to continue with Cloud Pro.

es.question: ¿Por cuánto tiempo está incluido Cloud Pro con mi dispositivo?
es.answer:
• Founders Limited Edition — 24 meses de Cloud Pro incluidos
• Signature Edition — 12 meses de Cloud Pro incluidos
• Standard Edition — 6 meses de Cloud Pro incluidos

Cuando termina tu periodo incluido, todo sigue funcionando — simplemente regresas a Cloud Basic, a menos que decidas continuar con Cloud Pro.
